en.headline: Fire at Yau Lai Estate unit in Yau Tong leaves five injured
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze on the ninth floor of Sau Lai House shortly after 10.50am; one woman in her seventies was taken to hospital while about 100 residents were evacuated.
body: A fire broke out in a residential unit on the ninth floor of Sau Lai House at Yau Lai Estate in Yau Tong this morning, prompting the evacuation of around 100 residents.

Police and the Fire Services Department received multiple reports at about 10.49am. Firefighters deployed one hose and a smoke-extraction team and brought the blaze under control after roughly 29 minutes. Preliminary reports indicated five people were injured. A woman aged about 70, a resident of the affected flat, was conscious when taken by ambulance to United Christian Hospital. Four others sustained minor injuries and did not require hospital treatment.

Some residents of the unit and about 20 others on the rear staircase were briefly trapped but were later rescued safely. Thick smoke was reported from the flat. The cause of the fire is under investigation by the Fire Services Department.

zh.headline: 油塘油麗邨單位起火 初步5人受傷約百人疏散
zh.dek: 秀麗樓九樓單位上午約10時49分起火，消防約29分鐘後將火救熄；約70歲女住戶送聯合醫院，另有4人輕傷毋須送院。
body: 油塘油麗邨秀麗樓九樓一單位今日上午發生火警，約100名居民疏散。
警方及消防處於上午約10時49分接獲多人報案。消防員出動一條喉及一煙帽隊灌救，約29分鐘後大致將火救熄。初步有5名傷者，其中一名約70歲女住戶清醒由救護車送往聯合醫院；另外4人輕傷，毋須送院。
涉事單位住戶及約20名後樓梯居民一度被困，其後安全獲救。單位冒出濃煙。消防處正調查起火原因。
